articles.title: 22-Year-Old Receptionist Allegedly Killed by Live-in Boyfriend Over Suspected Infidelity
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 22-year-old woman was allegedly murdered by her live-in boyfriend following a heated argument over suspected infidelity in Bengaluru's Bellandur police station limits on Sunday morning.

body.html:
A 22-year-old woman was allegedly murdered by her live-in boyfriend following a heated argument over suspected infidelity in Bengaluru's Bellandur police station limits on Sunday morning.

The deceased has been identified as Aati Hangma Suba (22), a native of Sikkim who was working as a receptionist at a private salon in the city.

The accused, identified as Purba Lepcha, a native of Darjeeling, was employed as a waiter at a private hotel in Bengaluru.

According to senior police officials, the couple had been in a relationship and had moved to Bengaluru about a month ago. They were living together in Doddakannalli.

Investigators said the accused allegedly suspected the woman of being in contact with another man, leading to frequent disputes between the couple.

On Sunday morning, another argument reportedly broke out over the issue. As the altercation escalated, the accused allegedly attacked the woman with a kitchen knife and slit her throat, killing her on the spot.

Preliminary investigations indicate that the murder was triggered by the accused's suspicion regarding the victim's relationship with another person.

Bellandur police rushed to the scene after receiving information and took the accused into custody. A case has been registered, and further investigation is underway.

The victim's body has been sent for post-mortem examination, and police are probing all aspects of the case.

articles.title: Passenger Allegedly Dragged by E-Rickshaw in Delhi, Disturbing Video Sparks Safety Concerns

body.html:
A disturbing CCTV video from the Bhooto Wali Gali area under Nangloi Police Station limits in Outer Delhi has surfaced online, allegedly showing an e-rickshaw passenger being dragged on the road.

According to local accounts, the incident was allegedly deliberate, with the driver continuing to move the vehicle while the passenger was being dragged, raising serious concerns over passenger safety.

The victim is feared to have sustained injuries, although the extent of the injuries has not been officially confirmed.

The CCTV footage has triggered concern among local residents, who claim that reckless driving and unsafe practices by some e-rickshaw operators have become increasingly common in the area.

Residents have urged authorities to take strict action against those responsible and strengthen enforcement measures to ensure the safety of passengers and prevent similar incidents in the future.

No official statement has been issued regarding the incident or any police action so far. Further details are awaited.

articles.title: ₹2 Crore Insurance Murder Mystery: Ex-Soldier’s Wife, Alleged Lover Arrested as Viral Selfie Vid
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sensational murder case involving a retired soldier in Karnataka's Belagavi district has taken a dramatic turn after a selfie video allegedly recorded by the prime accused surfaced online, making fresh claims about the death and the alleged conspiracy behind it.

body.html:
A sensational murder case involving a retired soldier in Karnataka's Belagavi district has taken a dramatic turn after a selfie video allegedly recorded by the prime accused surfaced online, making fresh claims about the death and the alleged conspiracy behind it.

The case relates to the death of former soldier Sandeep Manjargi, a resident of Ghodageri village in Hukkeri taluk, who was initially believed to have died following a road accident on March 13, 2026.

Police have arrested his wife, Suma Manjargi, and her alleged lover, Pundalik Dombar, accusing them of murdering Sandeep to claim an insurance amount of ₹2 crore.

According to investigators, Sandeep was injured in a road accident while returning from the Hukkeri fair and died on the third day of treatment at a private hospital in Ghataprabha.

During the investigation, police alleged that Suma and Pundalik had poisoned Sandeep as part of a conspiracy to obtain the insurance money.

Police said the case came to light after Pundalik allegedly disclosed the murder following a dispute with Suma over sharing the insurance amount. According to investigators, Pundalik had demanded an equal share of the ₹2 crore insurance claim, but Suma allegedly refused, prompting him to reveal the incident to friends, who advised him to approach the police.

Based on the statements of both accused, authorities exhumed Sandeep's body in the presence of Belagavi Sub-Divisional Officer Shravan Nayak. A second post-mortem was conducted, and the remains and organs have been sent for forensic examination.

In a fresh development, a selfie video purportedly recorded by Pundalik has gone viral. In the video, he claims that he developed a close relationship with Suma while working in Sandeep's tea business after the former soldier retired from military service.

He further alleges that Suma had been administering sleeping pills and alcohol to her husband over a period of time and later instructed him to procure pesticide from their farm while Sandeep was hospitalised after the road accident. According to Pundalik, Sandeep died the following day.

In the video, Pundalik also claims that Suma had promised to share part of the insurance money with him and had planned to settle with him and their children after Sandeep's death.

Police have not officially verified the claims made in the viral video and are treating it as part of the ongoing investigation.

Meanwhile, investigators have detained two additional individuals for questioning over alleged attempts to tamper with forensic evidence. One of them is reportedly associated with the office of the city police commissioner and is suspected of interfering with forensic procedures, while another person is also being questioned for a similar role.

Sandeep's brother, Sanjay Manjargi, demanded strict punishment for the accused, saying the family had initially believed the death was accidental as there was no mention of poison in the first post-mortem report.

Senior police officials said all aspects of the case, including the alleged conspiracy, financial motive and possible evidence tampering, are being thoroughly investigated.

Further investigation is underway.

#Belagavi #Karnataka #CrimeNews #InsuranceFraud

articles.title: Two Uttarakhand Police Constables Accused of Molesting Local Woman, Protest Erupts Ahead of Ann
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A major controversy erupted at Uttarakhand's Kainchi Dham a day before the temple's annual foundation day celebrations after two police constables deployed on fair duty were accused of molesting the daughter of a local homestay manager, triggering protests and public anger.

body.html:
A major controversy erupted at Uttarakhand's Kainchi Dham a day before the temple's annual foundation day celebrations after two police constables deployed on fair duty were accused of molesting the daughter of a local homestay manager, triggering protests and public anger.

According to the woman's father, the incident occurred when his two daughters were returning from the temple. He alleged that the two constables, who were staying at a nearby homestay, misbehaved with one of the young women and were heavily intoxicated at the time.

The allegations sparked outrage among local residents, who reportedly caught the two policemen, assaulted them and took them to a nearby police outpost, where a large crowd gathered and staged a protest.

Senior police officials rushed to the spot after receiving information about the incident. Nainital Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) Manjunath TC described the matter as serious and said strict action had been ordered against the accused personnel while assuring a fair and impartial investigation.

According to local reports, medical examinations of the two constables reportedly confirmed alcohol consumption. Police are preparing to register a criminal case against them.

The incident has also intensified resentment among local traders and residents over security arrangements ahead of the Kainchi Dham foundation day fair, observed annually on June 15 and attended by lakhs of devotees from across the country.

Local traders alleged that the police had created a "curfew-like" atmosphere in the area by erecting barricades and restricting vehicle movement several days before the event, causing inconvenience to pilgrims, tourists and business owners.

Residents claimed that traffic restrictions and roadblocks were imposed three days ahead of the celebrations, a practice they said had never been followed in previous years. They accused the police of enforcing rules arbitrarily and disrupting normal life in the temple town.

The controversy has raised fresh concerns over security and crowd-management arrangements ahead of one of Uttarakhand's biggest religious gatherings. With lakhs of devotees expected to visit the globally renowned Kainchi Dham temple, attention is now focused on the outcome of the investigation and the administration's response.

articles.title: Man Allegedly Beaten to Death for Refusing to Massage Feet During Liquor Party, Three Arrested in UP
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 33-year-old Dalit man was allegedly beaten to death by three men in Uttar Pradesh's Lalitpur district after he refused to massage their feet during a liquor party, police said.

body.html:
A 33-year-old Dalit man was allegedly beaten to death by three men in Uttar Pradesh's Lalitpur district after he refused to massage their feet during a liquor party, police said.

The accused allegedly dumped the victim's body on a road in an attempt to make the murder appear as a road accident. Police have arrested all three suspects.

According to Additional Superintendent of Police Kalu Singh, Kotwali police received information on Sunday morning about a man lying unconscious on a road behind Varni Jain College near Gurunanak Dharamshala.

The victim was identified as Rajkumar alias Chhannu, who belonged to a Scheduled Caste community. He was taken to a hospital, where doctors declared him brought dead.

During the investigation, police found that Rajkumar had attended a liquor party at the residence of Samyak Rajnayak alias Rahi Jain in the Civil Lines area on Saturday night. Gajendra Narwaria alias Gajendra Singh Rajput and Gaurav Raikwar were also present at the gathering.

Police alleged that the three accused, who were under the influence of alcohol, asked Rajkumar to massage their feet.

"When he refused, the three men assaulted him with a belt and an iron rod, resulting in his death on the spot. To make the incident appear as a road accident, they later threw his body on the road," ASP Kalu Singh said.

Based on a complaint lodged by the victim's mother, police registered a case of murder along with relevant provisions of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act.

Police said all three accused have confessed to the crime during questioning.

The body has been sent for post-mortem examination, and further legal proceedings are underway.

#Lalitpur #UttarPradesh #Dalit #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: UP Woman Arrested for Allegedly Killing Husband with Lover After Sedative-Laced Kheer
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking murder case has emerged from Uttar Pradesh's Baghpat district, where a woman has been arrested for allegedly murdering her husband with the help of her lover after serving him kheer mixed with sedatives.

body.html:
A shocking murder case has emerged from Uttar Pradesh's Baghpat district, where a woman has been arrested for allegedly murdering her husband with the help of her lover after serving him kheer mixed with sedatives.

According to police, the victim, 34-year-old farmer Sachin Dagar of Naurozpur Gurjar village in the Baraut area, was found dead under suspicious circumstances on Saturday morning.

Initially, his wife, Rachna, told neighbours that Sachin's health had suddenly deteriorated and that he died after being taken to a hospital.

However, marks found on the victim's neck raised suspicions among family members and neighbours, prompting a police investigation.

During the probe, officers examined CCTV footage from the area, which allegedly showed a man entering the house at around 10:27 pm on Friday and leaving at approximately 3:27 am on Saturday.

A post-mortem conducted by a panel of two doctors reportedly concluded that the cause of death was strangulation and indicated that the body had been dragged.

Baghpat Superintendent of Police Suraj Kumar Rai said that during interrogation, Rachna allegedly confessed to her involvement in the crime and was subsequently arrested.

Police identified her alleged accomplice as Sonu, a resident of Ranchad village, whom Rachna reportedly met through Instagram. According to investigators, the two later developed a relationship, which Sachin had come to know about and opposed.

Police alleged that Rachna mixed five to six sedative tablets into kheer and served it to her husband. After he lost consciousness, she and Sonu allegedly strangled him to death.

While Rachna has been taken into custody, Sonu remains absconding. Police have formed multiple teams to trace and arrest him.

Further legal proceedings and investigation are underway.

articles.title: Woman Allegedly Opens Fire at Historic Satna Fort, Raja’s Wife Shot in Abdomen
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A simmering property dispute within the erstwhile Nagod royal family in Madhya Pradesh's Satna district turned violent on Thursday when a woman allegedly opened fire with a licensed rifle at the historic Parsmania Garhi, critically injuring Yogita Singh, police said.

body.html:
A simmering property dispute within the erstwhile Nagod royal family in Madhya Pradesh's Satna district turned violent on Thursday when a woman allegedly opened fire with a licensed rifle at the historic Parsmania Garhi, critically injuring Yogita Singh, police said.

The accused, identified as Sunita Parihar, has been arrested, and the licensed rifle allegedly used in the shooting has been seized. Police said a detailed investigation is underway to establish the sequence of events and circumstances leading to the incident.

According to the FIR, Yogita Singh, wife of Rupendra Singh alias Baba Raja, had gone to her ancestral house at Parsmania on Thursday afternoon along with her son, Prithudev Singh, and her brother, Nagendra Singh Rathore.

In her complaint lodged at Unchehara Police Station, Yogita alleged that Sunita Parihar, who was staying at the property, began abusing her and asked her to leave the house.

Yogita claimed that when she refused to leave, the accused threatened to kill her and allegedly opened fire with the intention of killing her. One of the bullets struck the left side of her abdomen.

She further alleged that shots were also fired at her sons and that the accused had assaulted her on previous occasions as well.

Family members claimed that multiple rounds were fired during the confrontation. Speaking to local media, Yogita's mother, Narendra Kumari, alleged that Sunita fired several shots from a window during the incident.

The injured woman was initially taken to a hospital in Satna and later shifted to a private hospital in Rewa, where she underwent surgery. Doctors said her condition is stable, but she remains under observation.

Satna Superintendent of Police Hansraj Singh confirmed the arrest of the accused and the recovery of the suspected weapon.

"The accused has been arrested, the weapon suspected to have been used in the incident has been recovered and is being examined. Multiple rounds were fired by the accused. A probe is on," the SP said.

The incident has drawn attention due to its connection with the historic Nagod princely family. The Nagod state was established in 1478 AD by the Parihar Rajputs and merged with the Indian Union in 1950. It was originally known as Unchahara after its former capital.

Further investigation is underway.

#Satna #MadhyaPradesh #RoyalFamily #Shooting

articles.title: Kerala Woman Booked Under POCSO After Teenager's Disclosure During Counselling
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 25-year-old woman from Kerala's Kannur has been booked under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act following allegations of sexual assault involving a 16-year-old girl.

body.html:
A 25-year-old woman from Kerala's Kannur has been booked under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act following allegations of sexual assault involving a 16-year-old girl.

According to police, the alleged incident occurred a few months ago at the survivor's residence in Kasaragod. The matter came to light after the teenager disclosed the alleged abuse during a counselling session, prompting her parents to file a complaint.

Investigators said the accused was a friend of the survivor's mother and was a frequent visitor to the family's home. Police have registered a case under the POCSO Act and said formal arrest proceedings will follow.

Authorities also stated that the accused is already facing three other POCSO cases registered at Taliparamba Police Station. Police are continuing their investigation and examining her alleged involvement in other offences.

#Kerala #Kasaragod #POCSO #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Youth Allegedly Stripped and Brutally Assaulted by Group in Uttar Pradesh’s Siddharthnagar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing incident from Uttar Pradesh's Siddharthnagar district has sparked outrage after a young man was allegedly stripped and brutally assaulted in public by a group of men. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A disturbing incident from Uttar Pradesh's Siddharthnagar district has sparked outrage after a young man was allegedly stripped and brutally assaulted in public by a group of men. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

The incident occurred under the Dumariyaganj police station limits, where the victim, identified as Abdul Mateen, a resident of Khargaula village, alleged that he was attacked while returning from his fiancée's house on the night of June 3.

According to Mateen, he had gone to Sekiua village to attend a wedding-related feast and was returning home at around 11 pm when a group of men stopped him on the road.

"They first asked my name and address and then started beating me mercilessly," the victim alleged.

Mateen claimed that the attackers, identified as Siraj, Rafiq, Sonu, Abrar and others, surrounded him, stripped him and assaulted him severely.

"They undressed me and beat me on my private parts and other parts of my body. They also tried to kill me," he alleged.

The victim said he managed to escape after local residents intervened and stopped the assault.

The video of the incident has since gone viral, triggering widespread outrage and demands for strict action against the accused.

Mateen further alleged that despite approaching the Dumariyaganj police station, no effective action was initially taken and claimed that the accused continue to roam freely while threatening him.

"They are roaming freely and threatening to kill me," he said, urging senior police officials to ensure his safety and arrest those involved.

Police, however, denied allegations of inaction. Officials from Dumariyaganj police station said a complaint had been received and an FIR had been registered against the accused under relevant sections of the law.

"We have registered a case and investigation is underway," a police official said, adding that appropriate legal action will be taken.

Further investigation is in progress.

#UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #CrimeNews #PoliceInvestigation #BreakingNews
